text_block_list.text:
—The final day of summer training camp.
Tosen Jordan was running.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Jordan-san, here we go!!
Bakushin, bakushiiin!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Bakushin Bakushiiiiin!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Bakushin Bakushiiin?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Bakushin Bakushiiiiin!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Phew... That was a nice Bakushin...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Damn fast, as usual...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Still, today is the final day!
Give it everything you've got! No holding back!
Let's run one more time after a short break!"

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Ehh...? Is Tosen Jordan running with
Sakura Bakushin O again...?

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Their distance aptitudes are completely different anyway...
Put a stop to that ridiculous joint training.
It's not doing either of them any good.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...I'm hearing all sorts of voices.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Still, Bakushin O's stamina and
Jordan's speed have both gone up.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Then that training was worthwhile
for the two of them. Right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. Yeah, exactly.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Jordan!
Let me join in too☆ Bakushin, bakushiiin!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, another one went.
You going too, City?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, I'll keep you company.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Jordan! I'm gonna go full-on demon-runner in my next Bakushin too~☆

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Helios too!?
If all three of us run—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"I don't mind at all!
No matter how many people Bakushin together, Bakushin is always wonderful!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Then add two more to that,
and all five of us will go full Bakushin.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Palmer!?
And City too!?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty, off we go~.
Bakushin, bakushiiin!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin Bakushiiin!
I'll be taking the lead, thank you very much~!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh...?
Huuuh...?
choice_data_list: If you don't hurry, you won't be in the lead!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ehh~!? I don't want that either though~?!

On the final day of summer camp, shouts of "Bakushin!"
continued to echo across the beach.
